functions.data/mcp/function/weapon_devolution_rule:
scoreboard players add currentRule variables 1
playsound minecraft:entity.experience_orb.pickup master @a ~ ~ ~ 10 2 1
effect give @a minecraft:regeneration 1 20 true
execute if score currentRule variables matches 1..2 run schedule function mcp:weapon_devolution_rules 3s
execute if score currentRule variables matches 1 run tellraw @a {fallback:"For each kill you get, your weapon gets downgraded in the following order: Laser Gun, Mighty Axe, Trident, Weak Sword, Sharp Snowballs.",translate:"mcp.weapon_devolution_rules.1",color:"dark_aqua",type:"translatable"}
execute if score currentRule variables matches 2 run tellraw @a {fallback:"The first player to get a kill with the final weapon (Sharp Snowballs) wins!",translate:"mcp.weapon_devolution_rules.2",color:"dark_green",type:"translatable"}
execute if score currentRule variables matches 3 run function mcp:ready_up_tellraw


execute unless score currentRule variables matches 1 run return 0

functions.data/mcp/function/player_circle.mcfuncti:
# Function prerequisites:
# 1. radius variables is set to the desired radius of the player circle
# 2. All players getting place in the circle are online and have a minigameplayer score of at least 1 with no duplicates. The scores should be one big straight
# 3. This function is getting executed at the position of the center of the circle
# 4. The players will get teleported(At Yaw=0 by default unless a rotation offset paramter is specified) and will get teleported in order of their minigameplayer score. The exception to this is in a 2v2 minigame where minigameplayer 2 and 3 are switched

kill @e[tag=rotationOffset]
execute unless entity @e[tag=center] store result score playersInCircle variables if entity @a[scores={minigameplayer=1..}]
execute unless entity @e[tag=center] run summon minecraft:marker ^ ^ ^1 {Tags:["rotationOffset"]}
execute unless entity @e[tag=center] run summon minecraft:marker ~ ~ ~ {Tags:["center"]}
execute as @e[tag=center,limit=1] at @s facing entity @e[tag=rotationOffset,limit=1] feet run tp @s ~ ~ ~ ~ ~
kill @e[tag=rotationOffset]
execute unless score gametype variables matches 2 run scoreboard players add minigameplayer variables 1
execute if score gametype variables matches 2 if score minigameplayer variables matches 4.. run scoreboard players add minigameplayer variables 1
execute if score gametype variables matches 2 if score minigameplayer variables matches 2 run scoreboard players set minigameplayer variables 4
execute if score gametype variables matches 2 if score minigameplayer variables matches 3 run scoreboard players set minigameplayer variables 2
execute if score gametype variables matches 2 if score minigameplayer variables matches 1 run scoreboard players set minigameplayer variables 3
execute if score gametype variables matches 2 unless score minigameplayer variables matches 1.. run scoreboard players set minigameplayer variables 1
execute as @a[scores={minigameplayer=1..}] if score @s minigameplayer = minigameplayer variables at @e[tag=center] run function mcp:player_circle_place_player
scoreboard players operation rotationChange variables = 360 constants
scoreboard players operation rotationChange variables /= playersInCircle variables
execute as @e[tag=center,limit=1] run function mcp:rotate_entity
execute unless score minigameplayer variables >= playersInCircle variables run function mcp:player_circle
kill @e[tag=center]
scoreboard players reset radius variables
scoreboard players reset rotationChange variables
scoreboard players reset rotation variables
scoreboard players reset playersInCircle variables
scoreboard players reset minigameplayer variables

functions.data/sentry/function/shoot_arrow_1.mcfun:
#===Trajectory Calculation===
#calculate vertical multiplier
function sentry:trig/cos_rx
scoreboard players operation @s vert_mult = @s math_out
execute store result storage sentry:sentry vert_mult double 0.001 run scoreboard players get @s vert_mult
#execute store result score @s vert_mult run data get storage sentry:sentry vert_mult
#calculate x motion
#formula is (x rotation * vertical multiplier) / 1000000
function sentry:trig/sin_ry
scoreboard players operation @s math_out *= @s vert_mult
#					Maximum is   0.00001
execute store result storage sentry:sentry rx double 0.00001 run scoreboard players get @s math_out
#calculate z motion
#formula is (z rotation * vertical multiplier) / 1000000
function sentry:trig/cos_ry
scoreboard players operation @s math_out *= @s vert_mult
#					Maximum is   0.00001
execute store result storage sentry:sentry rz double 0.00001 run scoreboard players get @s math_out
#calculate y motion
#formula is y rotation / 1000
function sentry:trig/sin_rx
#					  Maximum is 0.01
execute store result storage sentry:sentry ry double 0.01 run scoreboard players get @s math_out

#===Arrow Shooting Part===
# if shooting non-arrow entities, change all instances of 'arrow' below to the desired entity, as well as the target selectors as appropriate.
execute at @s anchored eyes run summon minecraft:arrow ^ ^ ^0.5 {Tags:["init"]}
execute at @s run data modify entity @e[type=minecraft:arrow,tag=init,sort=nearest,limit=1,nbt={life:0s}] Owner set from entity @e[type=!minecraft:arrow,sort=nearest,limit=1] UUID

execute if score minigame variables matches 435 run data modify entity @n[type=minecraft:arrow] item.components."minecraft:potion_contents" set value {potion:"minecraft:fire_resistance"}
execute if score minigame variables matches 410 run data modify entity @n[type=minecraft:arrow] damage set value 1.25d
